hero.title: Zero-Knowledge Local Tunneling
hero.tagline: Passerelle exposes your local services through ephemeral Cloudflare tunnels. Fast, secure, and orchestrated by a gateway you control.

items.title: Cloudflare Tunneling
items.desc: Expose local services globally without compromising your network. Built securely on proven Cloudflare tunnels.

items.title: Zero-Knowledge
items.desc: The gateway cannot interfere with your personal instance, because the instance itself verifies all access requests.

items.title: Self-Hosted
items.desc: Run the gateway yourself. Orchestrate your ephemeral tunnels directly on your own infrastructure.

features_ext.title: Features
features_ext.tagline: Everything you need to orchestrate local tunnels securely.

items.title: Direct Link Access
items.desc: Instant, secure URL access to your exposed local ports.

items.title: PWA Dashboard
items.desc: Manage and orchestrate all your active tunnels through a beautiful web UI.

items.title: Zero Tunnel Management
items.desc: Ephemeral lifecycles handled automatically by the daemon.

items.title: One-Time QR Access
items.desc: Handoff authorization between devices via single-use QR codes.

items.title: 5-Minute Setup
items.desc: Frictionless deployment. Get your first tunnel running in under 5 minutes.

items.title: LAN Wide Exposure
items.desc: Proxy any device or service on your local network, not just localhost.

items.title: End-to-End Security
items.desc: Zero-trust architecture ensuring all data streams remain encrypted.

items.title: No Registration
items.desc: Anonymous usage out of the box with zero signups or accounts required.

items.title: Self-Host Gateway
items.desc: Decentralized by design. Point the daemon to your own self-hosted gateway anytime.

support.title: Support
support.mission: We believe in privacy by design. The public Passerelle gateway does not collect, harvest, or sell any user data. However, maintaining reliable global infrastructure requires resources.
support.donations: Donations are highly appreciated to keep the public gateway fast and free.
support.disabled: Donations are temporarily disabled. You can still reach out to help or sponsor the project via email.
